content_sections.heading: SJVN Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: SJVN Limited has issued for the engagement of 100 Graduate, Technician (Diploma) and Technician (ITI) Apprentices for one-year training. The short notice contains trade-wise seats, basic educational qualifications, age criteria, category-wise relaxation, stipends, domicile eligibility and application dates. The detailed notification also gives the application fee, merit-based selection criteria, 25% seat preference for Project Affected Families and Areas, eligibility conditions and the online application procedure. Official Recruitment Website: SJVN Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: SJVN Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - 100 Posts
content_sections.text: SJVN has announced 100 apprenticeship seats across Graduate, Diploma and ITI categories. The largest number of vacancies is available for Graduate Apprentices, followed by ITI Apprentices and Diploma Apprentices.

content_sections.heading: SJVN Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification for their selected apprenticeship discipline. Graduate Apprentices require a relevant Engineering Degree, Diploma Apprentices require an Engineering Diploma, and ITI Apprentices need Matriculation with the specified ITI qualification. Candidates must be eligible in age and qualification as on the closing date and can apply for only one trade or discipline; if a candidate applies more than once, only the latest application will be considered. Result-awaited candidates, candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training in SJVN, candidates already registered and trained under BOAT/NAPS, and candidates with one year or more of training or job experience after completing their education are not eligible. Candidates whose result was declared more than five years before training starts are also not eligible. Candidates applying for Graduate Apprentice posts must possess a full-time four-year Bachelor's Degree in Engineering in the relevant discipline from an institution or university recognized by AICTE. Technician (Diploma) Apprentice applicants must have completed a full-time three-year Polytechnic Diploma in Engineering in the relevant discipline from an institution recognized by AICTE or the State Board of Technical Education. ITI Apprentice candidates must have passed Matriculation (Class 10) and completed a regular full-time ITI course in the respective trade recognized by NCVT or SCVT. Yes, with the required ITI qualification. Candidates who passed Class 10 and completed a recognized regular ITI course in one of the advertised trades can apply for eligible Technician (ITI) Apprentice positions. Passing Class 10 without the prescribed ITI qualification does not satisfy the notified eligibility. Yes. Eligible candidates with a full-time four-year B.E./B.Tech. degree in the relevant advertised engineering branch can apply for Graduate Apprentice posts. Yes. Candidates with a recognized full-time three-year Engineering Diploma in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical or Information Technology can apply for Technician (Diploma) Apprentice positions.

content_sections.heading: SJVN Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum age for SJVN apprenticeship training is 18 years and the maximum age is 30 years as on the application closing date, 17 December 2026. Age relaxation is available according to the applicable category and disability provisions. Candidates must possess valid certificates supporting their claims.

content_sections.heading: SJVN Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly stipend during the one-year apprenticeship training period. Important: These amounts are apprenticeship stipends and should not be represented as salaries for permanent SJVN employment.

content_sections.heading: SJVN Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee must be paid online on the e-recruitment portal by Debit Card, Credit Card or Internet Banking. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstance.

content_sections.heading: SJVN Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: There will be no interview . Eligible candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of a merit list formed from the marks secured in Matriculation (10th), 12th and the ITI Course, Diploma or Engineering Degree, with the following weightage: In case of a tie in total marks, the candidate older in age will be considered senior. Shortlisted candidates must produce all original certificates at the time of verification and a certificate of medical fitness before joining. Lists of shortlisted and finally selected candidates will be published on www.sjvn.nic.in, and call letters will be sent only by email to the registered email ID.

rows.merit_weightage: 20% to 10th, 20% to 12th or Diploma (whichever is higher, in case of both), 60% to aggregate in Engineering

content_sections.heading: SJVN Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Himachal Pradesh Domicile Requirement
content_sections.text: The recruitment is restricted to candidates who are domiciles of Himachal Pradesh. Only eligible Himachal Pradesh domicile candidates can apply for the notified Graduate, Diploma and ITI apprenticeship seats.

content_sections.heading: SJVN Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Reservation
content_sections.text: Reservation of seats for SC, ST, OBC Non-Creamy Layer, EWS and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities will be implemented according to the applicable provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961, and subsequent amendments. Applicants claiming reservation must possess valid category or disability certificates as required by the recruiting organization.

content_sections.heading: SJVN Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit online applications through the SJVN recruitment portal from 18 November to 17 December 2026 . Official Website: www.sjvn.nic.in Online Registration Start Date: 18 November 2026. Application Last Date: 17 December 2026. Applicants must read the detailed recruitment instructions before submitting their forms.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Satluj Jal Vidyut Nigam (SJVN) is conducting this recruitment for various apprentice positions across disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in SJVN Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 100 vacancies available for Graduate, Diploma, and ITI apprentice posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the important dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online registration commences on 18 November 2026 and the last date for submitting applications is 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Graduate Apprentices?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time 4-year Bachelor degree in Engineering in the relevant branch from a recognized institute or university.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SJVN Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age as on the closing date, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly stipend for ITI Apprentices?
faq.answer: Technician (ITI) Apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 12,500/-.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible to apply for these apprentice positions?
faq.answer: Only candidates who are domiciles of Himachal Pradesh are eligible to apply for the SJVN apprenticeship training program.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the apprenticeship training?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will undergo a one-year apprenticeship training program under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for SJVN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online through the official recruitment portal available on the SJVN website.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of SJVN?
faq.answer: The official website of Satluj Jal Vidyut Nigam is www.sjvn.nic.in where candidates can access the notification and online application portal.
